All four defects are fixed, tested, and verified. Here is the summary.

## Result
- Goal/task: G-20260804T082618610097Z-21ffeb4e / T-20260804T082618611335Z-02de0043
- Role: Implementer
- Status: ready (implementation complete, all local gating suites green; the Shiki loop owns commit/PR/merge)

## What changed or decided
Fixed four adversarial defects on the Guardian approval surface, each with its own test:

1. **PAGINATION** — Added `--paginate` to the three guardian-evidence `gh api` calls in `shiki-mergegate.yml` (matching `shiki-cca-completion.yml`); `|| echo "[]"` fallbacks left byte-identical. Added a control-plane assertion (`test_shiki_guardian_policy.sh` + `test_guardian_approval_binding.py`) requiring `--paginate` on every guardian-evidence call in **both** workflows, non-vacuously (it also verifies all three endpoints are present).
2. **EMPTY HEAD SHA** — `_comment_source` no longer passes vacuously when `head_sha` is `''`; an empty head under `require_head_sha` now produces the same stale-comment soft blocker (the old `'' in body` was always True).
3. **POSITIONAL HEAD BINDING** — Replaced the whole-body substring test with `_head_sha_binding_blocker`: exactly one 40-hex token standing on its own line, equal to `head_sha` (the `build_approval_body` shape). Zero/prose-quoted, two-plus, abbreviated, and mismatched all soft-block with a named reason. Extraction stays **after** the marker/negation/`_configured_guardian`/`_author_allowed` checks — a non-Guardian comment is never parsed for a SHA.
4. **PATCH TARGET** — The guardian-status PATCH picker in `shiki-cca-completion.yml` now selects only `github-actions[bot]`-authored comments; still posts a new comment when none exists.

**Fixture migration:** Canonicalized every approving fixture across the five holders to the `build_approval_body` shape (`marker\n\nHEAD`); renamed `test_line_initial_marker_approves` → `test_loose_prose_marker_does_not_approve` (now asserts the loose form does **not** approve, without weakening it). `test_shiki_control_plane.sh`'s placeholder `abc123` head was promoted to a full 40-hex SHA (carried across `headRefOid`, all `statusCheckRollup[*].headSha`, and the CCA verdict) since positional binding requires a real object name. Added tightening prose to `docs/agents/guardian-policy.md` (all `validate_shiki` needles preserved).
